rationale: The primary model matches the reference: DESeq2 Wald with ~ sex + age + condition, sex as factor, age centered, contrast on condition, apeglm shrinkage, BH at stated thresholds, and an explicit pre-model check of sex/age balance with a documented fallback if a covariate is collinear with treatment; the sensitivity analysis is correctly subordinated to the full model. QC includes PCA, sample distances and library sizes but does not say figures are colored by condition/sex/age, omits the XIST/Y-linked sex check at the QC stage, and gives no outlier or shallow-sample policy. No low-count filter is stated anywhere, and size-factor normalization is only implicit in the choice of DESeq2. Enrichment was not warranted and is included anyway; it names the collection and ranking metric but gives no version, ORA universe, or set-size window. The report specifies design, thresholds, gene counts and design caveats but not package versions.
